texts.R1: Group silent for {{idleMin}} min: no events, no open call, no queue, no question
texts.R1b: Question waiting for an answer for {{waitMin}} min
texts.R2: Cache went cold after a {{gapMin}} min pause: {{writeK}}K tokens of the window written again, loss ≈ {{lostW}} window units
texts.R3: Context compacts too often: two compactions within {{gapMin}} min, {{count}} in the last hour
texts.R4: The same check runs in a loop with no edits between runs — runs: {{runs}}
texts.R5: Review launched while still in the work stage — review launches: {{spawns}}
texts.R6: Push or MR before the delivery stage — attempts: {{ops}}
texts.R7: The copy reads the panel’s own files — reads: {{reads}}
texts.R8: The group spends a lot: {{perHour}} window units per hour
texts.R9: The five-hour window will be {{projectedPct}} % full at reset (now {{nowPct}} %, reset in {{resetMin}} min)
texts.R9level: The five-hour window is already at {{nowPct}} %: the {{levelPct}} % level is passed, reset in {{resetMin}} min
texts.R9levelWeek: The weekly window is already at {{nowPct}} %: the {{levelPct}} % level is passed, reset in {{resetHours}} h
texts.R9week: The weekly window will be {{projectedPct}} % full at reset (now {{nowPct}} %, reset in {{resetHours}} h)
texts.R10: Subscription limit hit, reset in {{resetMin}} min
texts.R11: The agent waits in a sleep-and-check loop — rounds: {{polls}}
texts.R12: One file reread with no edit — reads: {{reads}}
texts.R13: Many subagents at once — launches: {{spawns}}, spending {{subW}} window units
texts.R14: A tool returned a huge result: {{charsK}}K chars into the window (such results: {{results}})
texts.R15: A call was cut off by its own {{timeoutMin}} min timeout (such calls: {{timeouts}})
texts.R16: A call has been open for {{openMin}} min, still inside its timeout
texts.R16bg: A background task has been open for {{openMin}} min: no word of its end, no stop
texts.R16slow: A call ran {{ranMin}} min — longer than the threshold (slow calls in half an hour: {{calls}})
texts.R16slowExpect: A call ran {{ranMin}} min, usually {{expectMin}} min (slow calls in half an hour: {{calls}})
texts.R17: Waiting in the heavy-step queue for {{waitMin}} min, {{ahead}} ahead
texts.R18: Guards keep refusing — denials: {{denials}} within {{spanMin}} min
texts.R19: Heavy first request of the session: {{firstK}}K tokens in the window
texts.R19grow: The session window grew by {{growK}}K tokens: {{firstK}}K at the first request (after a compaction, the first one after it), {{nowK}}K now — every call carries it again
texts.R20: The group is paused, yet a session acts: {{tools}} calls, starting {{afterMin}} min after the pause
texts.R21: Heavy checks in a loop: {{gates}} passes across the group, {{totalMin}} min in total
texts.R22: The group has stood for {{idleMin}} min: no turn, no question, no queue — it will not continue by itself
texts.R23: The same command gets stuck in {{groups}} groups within {{spanMin}} min — the cause is shared, not in a group
texts.R24: The same call fails with the same error, no edits in between — failures: {{fails}}
texts.R25: A refused action was done another way {{afterMin}} min after the refusal
texts.R26: The agent stops processes it did not start itself — calls: {{kills}}
texts.R27: The turn ended with a question in the text, without a card — waiting for an answer for {{waitMin}} min
texts.R28: Delivery reminders: {{nudges}}, yet the same things are still missing
texts.R28rounds: Delivery reminders: {{nudges}}, and the last round found {{fresh}} new missing items — delivery is being redone round after round
texts.R29: A tool that does not exist in the session was called — calls: {{calls}}
texts.R30: An external service does not answer: {{failures}} failures within {{spanMin}} min
texts.R31: Edits outside its own copy — actions: {{writes}}
texts.R32: CLI service inserts: {{insertK}}K chars within {{spanMin}} min
texts.R33: The review verdict is written as text, without a review block — the pipeline will not see it
texts.R34: A new conversation started over a warm one: {{writeK}}K tokens of a {{prevK}}K window written again, loss ≈ {{lostW}} window units
texts.R35: A new conversation redoes work already committed in this stage — files: {{files}}
texts.R36: The group is paused, yet a server its session started still listens — ports: {{ports}}
texts.R37: The turn brief is {{charsK}}K chars against a {{limitK}}K threshold: every turn carries it in the window again
texts.R38: A panel server restart waits on this group’s edits: {{files}} of its {{waiting}} files are the group’s — the restart will stop every live run
texts.R38done: The panel server restarted because of this group’s edits ({{files}} of its files), after waiting {{waitMin}} min for turns to end; other live groups at that minute: {{others}}
texts.R38wait: A panel server restart has waited {{waitMin}} min on this group’s edits: {{files}} of its {{waiting}} files are the group’s — while it waits the panel runs old code, and the restart will stop every live run
texts.R39: The panel server restarted {{restarts}} times in an hour: every restart breaks live runs — find what writes into its tree
texts.R40: The verify ledger in the group’s copy does not work as promised (findings in half an hour: {{findings}})
texts.R40mismatch: A replay from the verify ledger would differ from the real run: such a replay cannot be trusted
texts.R40mismatchExit: A replay from the verify ledger would differ from the real run: recorded exit {{recordedExit}}, real exit {{exit}}
texts.R40mode: The verify ledger in the group’s copy runs without replays: checks are only recorded
texts.R40off: The verify ledger is off for the group’s copy: its checks are neither recorded nor replayed
texts.R40replay: A check re-ran on a tree the verify ledger already holds green: the replay did not happen (findings in half an hour: {{findings}})
texts.R41: A check ran {{ranSec}} s past the verify ledger: not one event from the copy, it can never be replayed (such runs in half an hour: {{runs}})
texts.R42: A group run moved the windows: five-hour by {{fivePct}} %, weekly by {{weekPct}} %, {{mTokens}} M tokens in {{runMin}} min (heavy runs in half an hour: {{runs}})
texts.R42tokens: A group run used {{mTokens}} M tokens in {{runMin}} min, the window was not measured meanwhile (heavy runs in half an hour: {{runs}})
texts.R43: The group has been paused for {{pausedMin}} min with nothing for a person to decide — time to continue or close it
texts.R43watch: The watch paused the group {{pausedMin}} min ago and will not lift the pause itself — check the signal and continue
texts.R44: The turn summary admits a skip: part of the work is called unverified, temporary or a workaround
texts.R45: A decision has waited for a person for {{waitMin}} min: the panel did not grant it itself
texts.R46: Run summary: {{mTokens}} M tokens in {{runMin}} min, five-hour window +{{fivePct}} %, weekly +{{weekPct}} %; wasted {{wastePct}} % (rework {{reworkPct}} %, repeats {{repeatPct}} %, refusals {{deniedPct}} %)
texts.R46Bare: Run summary: {{mTokens}} M tokens in {{runMin}} min, five-hour window +{{fivePct}} %, weekly +{{weekPct}} %; the watch did not see the run’s calls
texts.R46tokens: Run summary: {{mTokens}} M tokens in {{runMin}} min, windows not measured; wasted {{wastePct}} % (rework {{reworkPct}} %, repeats {{repeatPct}} %, refusals {{deniedPct}} %)
texts.R46tokensBare: Run summary: {{mTokens}} M tokens in {{runMin}} min, windows not measured; the watch did not see the run’s calls
